messages:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident triggered: elevated 5xx rate observed on api-gateway-0 across us-west-2 and eu-central-1. Pager duty: high priority paging to oncall team.
Evan (oncall): I'm on it — seeing spike of 5xx + timeouts. Dashboard: 5xx rate jumped from ~0.2% to 8% in last 5m.
Katrina (sre): I can join. Any link to the alert runbook?
Evan (oncall): runbook: https://console.internal/runbooks/5xx-throttle - initial hypothesis: rate-limiter config pushed ~10m ago.
Miguel (infra): Confirming: we pushed a global quota patch to gateway-config at 2026-03-15T09:17:12Z. It narrowed token bucket refill/limit to reduce spikes. Might be mis-scoped.
Evan (oncall): Logs show a lot of 429s from the proxy followed by client retries, then upstream queue saturation -> 502/504/5xx. Example repeated:
```
[gateway] 2026-03-15T09:28:02Z INFO request_id=abc123 status=429 limit=120 window=60 tenant=team-a
[upstream] 2026-03-15T09:28:05Z ERROR connection reset by peer
```
Katrina (sre): So 429s at the edge are cascading into upstream failures. We should remove the new quota rule ASAP.
Miguel (infra): I'm rolling back the gateway-config patch now. Running: `kubectl -n gateway apply -f gateway-config-previous.yaml` and `curl -X POST https://config-api.internal/reload`
Evan (oncall): While rollback is in progress, can we temporarily increase global tokens to avoid further spill?
Miguel (infra): Patching on the fly: `PATCH /v1/config/token_bucket` payload: {"global_limit": 10000, "burst": 2000} - applied.
InfraBot: config change accepted, new global_limit=10000, burst=2000, change_id=chg-7890.
Evan (oncall): I'm seeing 429s tapering but still a lot of 5xx from the inference pool. Any backlog in message queues?
Katrina (sre): Checking queues: redis queue length for inference-pool worker-sets spiked to 120k, causing worker OOMs and restart loop. We need to drain and scale.
Miguel (infra): Scaling inference-worker ASG +2 instances (intentional warm start) and temporarily increasing prefetch to 50 to allow faster throughput. Commands: `terraform apply -var 'worker_count=24'` currently queued.
Evan (oncall): ETA on scale up?
Miguel (infra): +2 nodes green in 90s, but container restarts due to OOM need image-level restart; restarting pods: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-workers -n inference`
Evan (oncall): Restart done. 5xx downward trend now.
Katrina (sre): Noted customer impact: 7 customer tenants saw >30% error rate for 8-12m window. Product alerted growth@ and we should prepare comms.
Evan (oncall): Drafting a short status update: "We experienced elevated error rates caused by a mis-scoped rate-limit configuration that was deployed earlier. We've rolled back the config and scaled worker capacity. Services are returning to normal; engineering continues monitoring." Thoughts? :+1:
Miguel (infra): Add that we applied a temporary global limit increase and are investigating the root cause of the mis-scope.
Katrina (sre): Action items: 1) postmortem owner, 2) config gating to prevent global scope changes without canary, 3) add automated rollback when 429->5xx cascade detected.
Evan (oncall): Assigning pm: Katrina will take postmortem lead. I'll own immediate follow-ups and customer comms. Miguel will do config audit.
PagerDuty Bot: New incident channel created: #inc-5612348888. Handoff to next oncall: @Miguel at 10:00 UTC.
Miguel (infra): Quick forensic note: the gateway patch mistakenly used `scope: global` instead of `scope: region` due to templating bug in our deploy tool. Patch snippet: 
```
- limits:
    - scope: global
      tokens_per_minute: 120
```
Should have been `scope: region`.
Katrina (sre): That's the root cause. Add to infra audit. Also add a synthetic that triggers if %429 > 1% and 5xx increases by >0.5% within 3m to auto-open rollback runbook.
Evan (oncall): Customer outreach note: list impacted tenants + timeframe + mitigation steps + contact for follow-up. I'll queue in #customer-comm with draft.
Miguel (infra): Follow-up: I reverted the templating change and added an immediate unit test in deploy pipeline to assert scope field values. PR: https://git.internal/infra/merge/2456
Evan (oncall): Monitoring shows error rate back to baseline ~0.25% and 429s at normal levels. Closing alert in 10m if stable.
Katrina (sre): Logging postmortem items in backlog. We'll do a hotwash in 48h.
Evan (oncall): Thanks team. Final note: create a read-only dashboard for rate-limit diffs, add canary rollout for config changes. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident resolved. No active alerts for 15m.
Miguel (infra): I'll follow up with customers who reported repeated failures this morning.
Katrina (sre): Leaving notes for next oncall in the incident doc.
Evan (oncall): Handoff to @Miguel for monitoring and customer comms. I'm signing off.
